cds.text: Discuss how characters and settings are connected in these literary texts
Discuss characters, events and settings in different contexts in these literary texts
Recognise similar storylines, ideas and relationships in different contexts in these literary texts
Identify features of literary texts, such as characters and settings, and give reasons for personal preferences
Discuss connections between personal experiences and character experiences, and share preferences
Describe the effects of text structures and language features when responding to and sharing opinions
Discuss the characters and settings of a range of texts and how language presents them in different ways
Discuss how authors and illustrators use language and illustrations to portray characters and settings, and how settings and events shape mood
Discuss how authors and illustrators make stories engaging through character, setting and plot tension
Identify, reproduce and experiment with rhythmic sound and word patterns in poems, chants, rhymes or songs
Discuss how literary devices such as rhythm and onomatopoeia in poetry and prose shape meaning and reader reaction
Examine literary devices and deliberate word play, including in poetry, that shape meaning
Create and edit literary texts by adapting structures and language features of familiar texts through drawing, writing, performance and digital tools
Create and edit imaginative texts using or adapting language features, characters, settings, plot structures and ideas from literary texts
Create and edit literary texts by developing storylines, characters and settings
